messages.content: 我最近搬到了舊金山，並計劃前往Rivermist。這兩個地方有多遠？我想在開始這次冒險之前了解一下距離。

We need to estimate distance between two cities. We have a tool estimate_distance that takes cityA and cityB zipcodes. We need zipcodes. We can get zipcodes via get_zipcode_based_on_city. So we need to call get_zipcode_based_on_city for "San Francisco" and "Rivermist". Then call estimate_distance with those zipcodes. Then display result. So we need to chain calls. We\'ll first call get_zipcode_based_on_city for San Francisco. Then for Rivermist. Then estimate_distance. Then display. We\'ll use the tool.')
